# Packet — popol-vuh-005: The pride of Vucub Caquix and his sons; the two boys shoot him with the blowgun (fols. 6r–7v)

The established text (pinned) follows, one paragraph per block. A unit's `t` is cut from it by script (a sentence, or a long sentence or litany cut at a syntactic joint; couplets never split).

¶1
Vae vxe vchacatahic vyicoxic chi puch vꜫih Vucub Caquix cumal e caib ꜭaholab, Hunahpu vbi hun, Xbalanque vbi vcab.

¶2
Xavi e cabauil. Rumal iꜩel xquilo ri nimarizai rib, xrah vban chuvach Vꜭux Cah, xꜭha cu ri ꜭaholab: “Mavi vꜩ ta chuxoc; mavi chi ꜭaze vinac varal chuvach vleu. Quehe cut chi ca tih vvbaxic chuvi recha, chi ca vubah vi chiri, chi ca coh vi vyab, ta quizoc vꜫinomal, vxit, vpuvac, vcual, vyamanic ri cu cacabeh. Quehe cut chubano ronohel vinac. Mavi are chi vinaquir vi ꜫaꜫal ri xa puvac. Ta chuxoc,” xeꜭha ri ꜭaholab, huhun chi vb qui telen, qui cabichal.

¶3
Are cu ri Vucub Caquix e caib vꜭahol: are nabe al ri Zipacna; vcabal chi cut ri Cabracan; Chimalmat cut vbi qui chuch, rixoquil ri Vucub Caquix.

¶4
Are cu ri Zipacna are chire chaah ri nimac huiub, ri Chicac, Hunahpu, Pecul, Yaxcanul, Macamob, Huliznab, chuchaxic vbi huiub xꜭolic ta chi zaquiric; xa hun aꜫab chi vinaquiric rumal ri Zipacna.

¶5
Are ri chi cu ri Cabracan chi zilab huiub rumal, chi nebouic chuti huiub, nima huyub rumal.

¶6
Xavi quehe nimarizabal quib xquibano vꜭahol Vucub Caquix. “Ix va, in ꜫih,” xꜭha Vucub Caquix. “In va, in banol vleu,” xꜭha ri Zipacna. “In chi cut quiyou cah, chin vlih ronohel vleu,” xꜭha ri Cabracan.

¶7
Xavi vꜭahol Vucub Caquix, xavi chi vi xquicam vi qui nimal chirih qui cahau. Are cut iꜩel xquil ri ꜭaholab; maha chi bantah oc ca nabe chuch, ca nabe cahau. Quehe cut xnohix vi qui camic, qui zachic cumal ꜭaholab.

¶8
Vae cute vvbaxic Vucub Caquix cumal caib ꜭaholab. Xchicabyih qui chacatahic chi qui huhunal ri nimarizai rib.

¶9
Are ri Vucub Caquix hun nima che ri tapal; are cu recha ri Vucub Caquix. Are chulo ri vvach tapal, chacan chui che hutaꜫih; xilom acut rechabal cumal ri Hunahpu, Xbalanque.

¶10
Qui cacalen chi cut chuxe che ri Vucub Caquix; e maꜩamoh vlo ri caib ꜭaholab pa xac che. Ta xopon cut Vucub Caquix, tacal chui recha ri tapal.

¶11
Cate cut ta xubaxic cumal ri Hunhunahpu; tacal vbac vvb chu caꜫate; chu racuh vchi ta xpe chui che, tacal chuvach vleu.

¶12
Chi malmat cut ri Hunhunahpu, anim xbec; quiꜩih vi xbe vꜭhapa. Cate cut ta xcupix vlo vꜫab ri Hunhunahpu rumal ri Vucub Caquix; huzuc xꜩac vloc, xmeho vloc ꜩam vteleb.

¶13
Ta xuꜩocopih chi cut Hunhunahpu ri Vucub Caquix; xavi vꜩ xquibano, ma nabe qui chacatahic tah rumal Vucub Caquix.

¶14
Vcaam chi cut vꜫab ri Hunhunahpu rumal ri Vucub Caquix, ta xbe chi rochoch; xa chi ꜫu vlo tem vcaꜫate xoponic.

¶15
“Naquipa mi xcamou chi la?” xꜭha cu ri Chimalmat, rixoquil Vucub Caquix. “Naquipa ri? Ri e caib ꜭaxtoꜭ mi xi quivubah, mi xzilibatah nu ꜫaꜫate rumal. Xa ca chuiu ahe ve, ca coxou chic. Mi nabe mi xnucam vloc chuvi ꜫaꜫ cut, chi xeque vi chi ꜩaiaba chuvi ꜫaꜫ, ta cul qui cama chic quiꜩih chic ꜭaxtoꜭ,” xꜭha ri Vucub Caquix, ta xuxequeba vꜫab ri Hunahpu.

¶16
Qui naohinic chic ri Hunhunahpu, Xbalanque; ta xquibih cut chirech hun mama, quiꜩih zac chic rizmal vi chi mama, hun cu atit, quiꜩih quemel atit chic, xa que lucuquila chic chi rihtac vinac.

¶17
Zaqui Nimac vbi mama; Zaqui Nima Ꜩiz cut vbi atit.

¶18
Xeꜭha cu ri ꜭaholab chique ri atit, mama: “Quix cachbilah tah chi be ta cama ca ꜫab ruꜭ Vucub Caquix. Xa coh tere chivih. Qui ri ca mam ri cachbilan; caminac qui chuch, qui cahau; quehe cut que tere cohila vi chiquih tala que ca zipah vi; rumal xa elezan vchicopil eiah ca ca bano, quix ꜭha. Quehe cu ri oh acalab chi rilo ri Vucub Caquix; xavi oh ꜭoh yauic i naoh,” xeꜭha ri e caib ꜭaholab. “Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha cut.

## Establishment log (doubtful readings, letters chosen, supralinear words — the notes must say so)

# Establishment log — popol-vuh-005 (images 0021–0024)

Read 2026-11-24 from source/pages/i0021 (from line 13), i0022, i0023 and the first word of i0024, in strips at
1.5× with 2.2–3× crops of every doubtful word, checked word by word against Brasseur 1861 (OCR lines
19750–20100). Start: `Vae vxe vchacatahic vyicoxic …` (0021, line 13, right after `… rumal Ahꜯac, Ahbit.`).
End: `“Vꜩ bala,” xeꜭha cut.` — the last line of 0023 (`… vꜩbala xeꜭha-`) runs over to the first word of 0024
(`cut.`). The next sentence, `Cate cut ta xebec ꜩamal cubi ri Vucub Caquix …` (0024 line 1), begins the
visit of the old couple to Vucub Caquix and belongs to popol-vuh-006.

Cut: parts.json planned 0021–0023; the part ends at the foot of 0023 (+ one word of 0024), at the end of the
boys' instructions to the old couple and the couple's assent.

## Folios
Counting as 004 did (0021 = 6r): 0022 = 6v, 0023 = 7r, 0024 = 7v → `fols. 6r–7v`. The crops of 0022 and
0024 carry the numbers 6 and 7 at the top left of the K'iche' column, consistent with the doubt recorded
in QUESTIONS.md (2026-11-24); the earlier count is kept meanwhile.

## Letter rule used (002–004's rules, unchanged)
- q-shaped letter (+ u) where Brasseur has g → ꜫ, u dropped: `vꜫih`, `vꜫinomal`, `hutaꜫih`, `ꜫih` (Ix va, in ꜫih).
- tresillo (ɛ/3-shape) → ꜫ: `ꜫaꜫal`, `aꜫab`, `vꜫab` ×4, `ca ꜫab`, `chu caꜫate`, `vcaꜫate`, `nu ꜫaꜫate`,
  `chuvi ꜫaꜫ` ×2, `chi ꜫu vlo`.
- g-shaped letter → ꜭ: `ꜭaholab` (all), `vꜭahol` ×2, `xꜭolic` (B. qolic), `ꜭaxtoꜭ` ×2 (both letters g-shaped;
  B. qaxtok), `ꜭoh` (B. qoh), `ruꜭ` (B. ruq); gh → ꜭh: `xꜭha` ×6, `xeꜭha` ×4, `quix ꜭha`, `vꜭhapa` (B. u chapa
  — the image has gh; modern chap has plain ch, so the drafter should note it).
- q-shaped letter where Brasseur has q (= ꜭ): `Vꜭux Cah` (as in every earlier part), `chi ꜭaze` (B. chi qaze).
  These two q-forms are not the g-shape; ꜭ was taken from Brasseur's reading.
- plain c kept where Brasseur has q, k or g: `xquicam` (B. qam), `xnucam`, `mi xcamou` (B. qamou), `qui cama`
  (B. gama), `Qui cacalen` (B. qakalem), `cu cacabeh` (B. gagabeh), `pa xac che` (B. xak), `chacan` (B. ch'akan),
  `chi racuh`, `Chicac`, `Yaxcanul`, `Zaqui Nimac` (B. Zaki-Nim-Ak), `acalab`.
- tz ligature → ꜩ: `iꜩel` ×2, `vꜩ` ×3, `maꜩamoh`, `xꜩac`, `ꜩam vteleb`, `xuꜩocopih`, `quiꜩih` ×4, `chi ꜩaiaba`,
  `Zaqui Nima Ꜩiz`.
- ß-ligature read ti: `chi ca tih` (MS chicaßh), `chuti huiub` (MS chußhuiub), `atit` ×3.

## Doubtful readings
- `ri nimac huiub` (0021): clear in the image; B. prints `ri napak huyub`. Image followed.
- `cu cacabeh` (0021): MS `ri cuca-|cabeh`; B. one word `gagabeh`. Divided cu + cacabeh as `cu nimarizah`.
  Meaning uncertain.
- `vcabal` (0021): the c is retraced in heavy ink and looks like a k; Ximénez writes no k anywhere else.
  Printed c (B. u cabal).
- `Zipacna` (0021): the first occurrence has a cedilla, `Zipaçna`; the others plain c. Printed c throughout.
- `chire chaah` (0021): MS `chirechaah`; divided as Brasseur (`chire chaah`).
- `xchicabyih` (0022): the i after ch is a blot; read as in 004 (`xchicabyih`).
- `xilom acut` (0022): MS `xilo macut`; divided as Brasseur (`x-ilom akut`), acut the particle.
- `xopon cut [caib ꜭaholab] Vucub Caquix` (0022): Ximénez struck through `caib ꜭaholab`; left out.
- `Chi malmat cut ri Hunhunahpu` (0022): MS `chimalmat`, the same letters as the wife's name; divided as
  Brasseur (`Chi malmat`, 'hastily'). Doubtful.
- `Hunhunahpu` (0022–0023, ×5) against `Hunahpu` (0021 and 0023 `vꜫab ri Hunahpu`): printed as written.
- `ri` (0023, `vꜫab ri Hunhunahpu`): a small k is written above and after `ri` in a lighter hand; not printed.
- `xa chi ꜫu vlo tem vcaꜫate` (0023): the letter after chi is a tresillo; the vowel after it is a or u (B. cu).
  `vcaꜫate` may also be read `vcoꜫate`. Meaning of the line inferred from B. ('holding his jaw').
- `chuvi ꜫaꜫ` (0023): underlined twice in darker ink, with a bracketed marginal note `u cab ri hunhunahpu`
  (struck through) in the same ink — a later reader's gloss, not printed. It says what was put on the fire.
- `chi ꜩaiaba` (0023): MS `chi ꜩa-|iaba`; B. tzayaba.
- `xquibih` (0023): the first letter after qui may be h (`xquihih`); B. `qui-bih`. Printed b.
- `hun cu atit` (0023): MS `hunca` or `huncu`; B. `hun atit`. Printed cu, the particle.
- `chi rihtac vinac` (0023): MS `chirihtac`; B. `chi rihitak`. Divided chi + rihtac.
- `Zaqui Nima Ꜩiz` (0023): MS `zaquinimaꜩiz`; B. Zaki-Nima-Tzyiz.
- `quix ꜭha` (0023): MS `quixgha`. The boys' instructions contain the words the old couple are to say (`Qui ri
  ca mam … ca ca bano`); not set in inner quotation marks (the checks forbid ’), so the drafter must show
  the embedded speech in the English.

## Word division (ours)
As in 002–004: v- possessive joined (`vvbaxic`, `vxit`, `vpuvac`, `vcual`, `vyamanic`, `vbac vvb`, `vchi`);
nu, qui, ca possessives apart; optative `chi ca` apart (`chi ca tih`, `chi ca vubah`, `chi ca coh`); x + absolutive
apart (`xi quivubah`); `mi` apart. Paragraphs follow Ximénez's stops and Brasseur's paragraphing; each speech is
kept in one paragraph so the quotation marks close within it. The large capital V of `Vae cute vvbaxic` (0022)
begins the shooting episode as its own paragraph. No supralinear words in this stretch.
